name: astryx
description: Teaches coding agents that Astryx is available through the astryx command, when to use it, and where to start.

interface.shortDescription: Build UI with the Astryx design system through its CLI
interface.longDescription:
Astryx is a design system and UI library. This plugin tells coding agents that Astryx is available on this computer through the astryx command, when to use it, and where to start.

Use it when building or changing UI, choosing components, layout, styling or theming, working with a design system, or in any project that depends on @astryxdesign packages. The skill points agents at astryx search, component docs, templates, and astryx init — not at reading package source. If astryx is missing, it tells the agent to install @astryxdesign/cli first.

The skill text is the same guidance the global CLI install writes to ~/.agents/skills/astryx/SKILL.md.
defaultPrompt: Build a settings page with Astryx components
Scaffold an Astryx template for a dashboard
Find the right Astryx component for a date picker
